function.name: mcp_servers
function.description: List the configured MCP servers with their transport, connection state, tool count and any error. Use this first when an MCP tool is missing or failing.

refresh.description: Reconnect and re-read every server's tool list before answering.

function.name: mcp_tools
function.description: List the tools the connected MCP servers offer, with their parameter names. Each one can be called with mcp_call, or directly by its mcp__<server>__<tool> name when it is declared.

server.description: Only list the tools of this server.

refresh.description: Ask the servers again instead of using the cached catalogue.

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return.

function.name: mcp_search_tools
function.description: Load the full definitions (description and input schema) of MCP tools that are not declared in this request. The runtime context lists them under mcp.deferred_tools by name and one line; search by words or exact names, then run one with mcp_call.

query.description: Words describing what the tool should do, or an exact tool name.

names.description: Exact tool names (mcp__<server>__<tool> or the server's own name) to load.

server.description: Only search the tools of this server.

limit.description: How many definitions to return (1-25, default 5).

refresh.description: Ask the servers again instead of using the cached catalogue.

function.name: mcp_call
function.description: Call a tool on an MCP server. Use this for any server tool, including one that is not declared as its own function. Name the server and the tool, or pass the full mcp__<server>__<tool> name as tool.

server.description: Server name, as reported by mcp_servers. Not needed when tool is a full mcp__<server>__<tool> name.

tool.description: Tool name on that server, or a full mcp__<server>__<tool> name.

arguments.description: Arguments for the tool, matching the schema mcp_tools reports.

timeout_ms.description: Override the call timeout for this one call.

function.name: mcp_add
function.description: Connect a new MCP server and make its tools available for the rest of the run. Give a command for a local stdio server, or a url for an http, sse or websocket one. The connection is proved before the server is kept.

name.description: Name to register the server under. Used as the prefix of its tool names.

transport.description: Transport to use. Inferred from command or url when omitted.

command.description: Executable or .js entry point for a stdio server.

url.description: Endpoint for an http, sse or websocket server.

env.description: Extra environment variables for a stdio server.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for a remote server.

token.description: Bearer token for a remote server.

include.description: Only expose these tools of the server.

exclude.description: Do not expose these tools of the server.

trust.description: How much approval calling this server needs. restricted always asks, trusted never does.

persist.description: Save the server to .agent/mcp.json so it is there next time. Defaults to true.

function.name: mcp_remove
function.description: Disconnect an MCP server and withdraw its tools for the rest of the run.

name.description: Name of the server to remove.

persist.description: Also remove it from .agent/mcp.json. Defaults to true.

function.name: mcp_resources
function.description: List an MCP server's resources and resource templates, or read one resource by its uri.

server.description: Server name, as reported by mcp_servers.

uri.description: Read this resource instead of listing them.

limit.description: Maximum number of resources to list.

function.name: mcp_prompts
function.description: List an MCP server's prompts, or render one prompt with its arguments into the messages it expands to.

server.description: Server name, as reported by mcp_servers.

name.description: Render this prompt instead of listing them.

function.name: mcp_build
function.description: Write a small dependency-free MCP server into the workspace (.agent/mcp-servers/<name>) from the node or python template, or from an OpenAPI JSON document, and load it at once: its tools are callable through mcp_call in this same conversation. After editing its tools file, call again with action reload.

action.description: create (default) writes and registers the server; reload restarts an existing one after its tools file was edited.

name.description: Server name: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.

tools.description: The tools, unless openapi is given.

body.description: Body of the handler: JavaScript for async handler(args) { … } or Python for def handler(args): …, returning the result.

openapi.description: A workspace path to an OpenAPI 3 JSON document, or the document itself; one tool per operation.

base_url.description: The API's base URL when the document has no absolute servers[0].url.

register.description: Start and load the server now (default true).

persist.description: Keep it for later runs (operator's user file, this project only). Default false: this process only.

overwrite.description: Replace a server of the same name already in the workspace.
